text:
maya: Heads-up: Hosted Toolkit (GA) is live for all hosted customers as of today. This bundles streaming + tool-calling into a single, supported surface. Docs, SDK releases, and console toggles are published. :sparkles:

devon: Awesome! Link?

maya: Internal docs: https://console.redwood.ai/internal/hosted-toolkit-ga (use SSO). Quick summary in this thread.

harry: Quick infra note: new canonical endpoint is `/v1/hosted-toolkit/stream`. It supports SSE and multiplexed frames for tool events. Auth is unchanged (API key). Older beta endpoints remain proxied for 60 days, then deprecated.

alicia: Support/process: Canary rollout to 5% of accounts started at 16:00 UTC. If you see a spike in 5xx or synchronous fallbacks, tag #incidents and ping oncall. We've added a dedicated dashboard (Host Toolkit GA) in the Console Monitoring space.

devon: SDK impact? Breaking changes?

maya: Minor. JS & Py SDKs add `ToolkitClient`; streaming helpers are opt-in. Upgrade to SDK >= v1.8.2 for full tool-call schema support. Existing chat endpoints continue to work unchanged.

harry: Routing: smart-routing now prefers low-latency QPUs for toolkit calls. If capacity constrained, requests may be routed to quantized-compatible variants. You can opt a customer into strict-pinned pools via the `X-Redwood-Route: pool=<name>` header.

alicia: Customer messaging: Marketing provided templates in Drive (folder: Hosted Toolkit GA). For enterprise customers on Dedicated, please coordinate with Account Execs before flipping the migration toggle.

devon: Any throttling or quota differences for toolkit routes?

alicia: Default quota unchanged. Toolkit routes expose per-route qps metrics; if a customer needs more throughput, file a Support+Sales joint request with expected qps and token profile.

harry: Note for engineering: some older model variants that lack tool hooks will return a single non-streamed payload. SDK will convert that into a standard response but call it out in migration docs. Also, we found one edge-case where a malformed tool schema caused the stream to close immediately  fixed in runtime patch 1.4.3 rolled at 15:50 UTC.

sre-bot: release-bot: release/hosted-toolkit-ga -> production: success at 2026-03-23T15:50:00Z :white_check_mark:

maya: Action items for teams: 1) Support & SE: review canary assignments and run the pre-built validation playbook `runbook hosted-toolkit-ga`. 2) Eng: watch the GA dashboard for P95 tail increases for first 72h. 3) PM/Docs: confirm migration guide includes code snippets for both SSE and WebSocket clients.

devon: I'll schedule the customer announcement for tomorrow 09:00 PT and include the migration checklist.

alicia: Added automated alerts for sudden increases in synchronous fallbacks (INT-4177). Also updated the public rate-limit page to mention toolkit routes.

harry: Small sample for docs (JS SDK):
```js
import { ToolkitClient } from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new ToolkitClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.stream({ model: 'mosaic-toolkit-7b', tools: [searchTool] });
for await (const ev of stream) {
  if (ev.type === 'tool_call') handleToolCall(ev);
}
```

maya: Thanks all. We'll host a 30min demo + Q&A at lunch (12:00 PST) and record it. RSVP via the calendar invite. If you find any customer-impacting bugs, escalate immediately.

devon: :thumbsup: will coordinate with Customer Success on pilot comms.

alicia: Filing a follow-up for a docs tweak: clarify behavior when models lack tool-call bindings (INT-4178).

maya: Closing note: celebrate the release but keep an eye on the metrics for the first 3 days. Kudos to the teams that shipped this! :partyparrot:
